statements.status_notes: JLine 3.9.0 classes are shaded inside hadoop-client-runtime pulled by Druid's Hadoop-based extensions. Druid does not start an interactive JLine shell or load org.jline reader builtins in the broker/historical/middleManager runtime; the shaded copies are not on an attacker-reachable execute path. Dependency management pins org.jline modules to 3.30.15 for non-shaded copies.

JLine 3.9.0 classes are shaded inside hadoop-client-runtime pulled by Druid's Hadoop-based extensions. Druid does not start an interactive JLine shell or load org.jline reader builtins in the broker/historical/middleManager runtime; the shaded copies are not on an attacker-reachable execute path. Dependency management pins org.jline modules to 3.30.15 for non-shaded copies.

jline is bundled for the interactive Gremlin console (jline-remote-telnet); the telnet server is not started by the default gremlin-server runtime. Upgrading to jline 4.x is a major bump; reachability assessment pending.

jline is bundled for the interactive Gremlin console (the standalone jline jar) and, as an older copy, shaded inside hadoop-client-runtime; the default gremlin-server runtime starts neither the console nor the jline telnet server. Fixed releases exist in the 3.x line (3.30.14 and 3.30.15), but the package currently pins jline 3.30.6 for dependency convergence with Kerby 2.1.2 and has not yet moved to them; reachability assessment pending.
